departures.title: Departures
departures.subtitle: Today's departures by station: times, ticket checks and incidents.
departures.empty-hint: Pick another day or another station.

luggage.title: Luggage
luggage.label-code: Code to write on the label:
luggage.subtitle: Find a piece of luggage by its label code and hand it over to the recipient.
luggage.no-match-hint: Check the code on the label: 8 letters and digits.
luggage.empty-hint: No luggage was registered on this day's departures.

track.delivered: Handed over to the recipient on {{time}}

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.subtitle: Delays, breakdowns and other events on the routes: follow them until they are closed.
incidents.new-hint: Incident on a route, not tied to a departure. For a departure, report it from its page.
incidents.empty-open-hint: Everything is in order on your routes.
incidents.resolution-hint: What was done: replacement bus, travellers informed…

scan.denied: Camera refused or unavailable: allow it in the browser, or type the code.
scan.unsupported: This browser cannot use the camera: type the code.
scan.subtitle: Scan the ticket's QR code or type its code.

routes.title: Routes & fares
routes.hint: Operator's price per passenger; Book In Pass fees are added. A new price applies to later bookings. Dakar time.

routes.none-hint: Create a route between two stations to put it on sale.
routes.new-hint: Route between two stations; then add its timetable.
routes.price-hint: Operator price, before Book In Pass fees.

staff.title: Staff
staff.issued: Temporary password for {{username}}, to pass on (shown only once):
staff.username-format: Lowercase letters, digits, dot, hyphen or underscore.
staff.subtitle: Staff accounts: roles, stations, access.
staff.none-hint: Create accounts for station chiefs and inspectors.
staff.reset-hint: The current password stops working; the new temporary one must be changed at first login.
staff.reset-message: {{name}}'s current password will stop working. A temporary password will be shown once, to pass on to them.
staff.new-hint: A temporary password is created and shown only once.
staff.password-hint: The temporary password is shown after creation: pass it on in person.

errors.images-unavailable: Photo storage is not configured on the server.

bookings.title: Transport bookings
bookings.query: Reference, phone or a passenger's last name
bookings.subtitle: Find a traveller's booking at the desk: tickets, payment, resending tickets.
bookings.none-hint: Only your station's routes are searched. Check the reference, the phone number or the spelling of the name.
bookings.start-hint: Type at least 2 characters: reference, phone or a passenger's name.

refunds.title: Refunds
refunds.hint: Wave / Orange Money payments received after the seats were resold: the customer has no ticket. Refund them from the PayDunya account or the operator, then record it here.
refunds.activities-hint: Refunds of activity bookings paid by mobile money: do them by hand, then record them here. With "already done", card refunds too.
refunds.subtitle: Mobile money payments to return by hand: refund the customer, then record it here.

transport.1: The customer paid with Wave or Orange Money after the seats were resold: they have no ticket.
transport.2: Refund them from the PayDunya account or through the operator (receipt and reference in the row).
transport.3: Record the refund here: operator, number, transaction reference.

activities.1: Activity booking paid by mobile money and cancelled: the refund is not sent automatically.
activities.2: Refund the customer from the operator account.
activities.3: Record it here. Card refunds go through Stripe and appear in the history.

refunds.none-hint: Payments to return will show up here.
refunds.no-history-hint: Recorded refunds will show up here.
refunds.confirm-message: Confirm that {{customer}} was refunded {{amount}} (booking {{reference}}). This cannot be undone.

activities.title: Activity catalogue
activities.hint: Tourist activities: content, options and prices, time slots, publication. Only published activities show on the site.
activities.none-hint: Create a first listing: content, photos, prices and time slots. It stays a draft until you publish it.
activities.no-match-hint: Try another title, city or status.

activity.city-hint: Type at least 2 letters, then pick the city: its time zone is used for time slots.
activity.slug-hint: Empty: made from the title. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
activity.images-hint: Photos are stored on our CDN; the first one is the main image.

image.drop: Choose photos or drop them here
image.formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF or AVIF · 10 MB max
image.base64-hint: With or without a data:image/…;base64, header
image.url-hint: The server downloads the photo and stores it on our CDN.

missing.title: Give a title.
missing.location: Give both latitude and longitude, or neither.
missing.images: Each photo needs an https:// address.

activity.summary-title: What travelers are saying (summary by Claude)
activity.summary-needs: At least 3 published reviews are needed.
activity.new-hint: Fill in the four steps; the listing stays a draft until you publish it.

steps.general-hint: What travellers see first on the activity page.

activity.itinerary-hint: The stops, in the order of the tour.

activity.meeting-hint: Address, and coordinates for the map (both or neither).
activity.options-after-create: Options (prices) and time slots can be added once the listing is created: click "Create activity".

status-hints.published: Visible and bookable on the site.
status-hints.archived: Removed from the site, kept here.

activity.archive-confirm: It will be removed from the site. Existing bookings are not cancelled.

options.title: Options and prices
options.hint: Prices per person in {{currency}}. Empty child price: no child rate. New prices apply to the next bookings.
options.name: Option name
options.none: No options: add one to be able to publish.

slots.open-hint: Time slots already open are kept; past dates are skipped. Up to {{date}} at most (two years).
slots.none: No time slots in this period.

activity-bookings.hint: All bookings, paid or not. Dates: day of the time slot (Dakar time).
activity-bookings.none-hint: Activity bookings will show up here.
